reviews.text: Best on the westside, I love Balanced Dog Grooming. 5 star service and great attention to detail. My dog loves coming here. Such a calming environment for my sensitive dog.
Balanced dog is the best  Ruben is always so helpful   My dog is treated so well and Kevin always does exactly what you want  Highly recommend ! A+ all around
I love Balanced Dog Grooming. I have a very shy little girl and they are amazing with her. She comes out so clean and smells great.
Balance Dog Grooming is amazing.  They are sensitive and caring and sweet to my little dog.. He looks fantastic
I knew Lola would receive excellent care as soon as I walked in. The staff was caring and did a great job grooming Lola! Will be back!
Kevin at Balanced Dog Grooming is amazing with my Samoyed, which is no easy feat!! He is so diligent and sweet and patient! She looks fabulous when I pick her up!

My dog is a large Golden Doodle and has thick wavy hair that is hard to manage.

Milo went to Beth today and came out looking beautiful and HAPPY! We have never had a groomer we were not happy with.

Great service! I brought a picture of my dogs ideal haircut after some horror stories at other groomers and they matched it perfectly! My dog also hates his paws being touched and they were so kind and patient with him! Will definitely be coming back
Kevin did an amazing job with my 2 year old cavapoo! Will be back!
Karl, my 115 lb Rottweiler (LapDog), had an amazing first visit today. The front desk concierge service provided by Ruben was the BEST. Yet, the pedicure that Karl received by Lily….FANTASTIC!
Convenient mobile service. They do a great job.

My dog can hardly wait for his grooming appointment with Kevin every 5 weeks. Not only does my pup run in and straight into Kevin’s arms with glee, he looks fantastic afterward. Kevin stays in time and for several years has given my dog a consistently good cut.
He is not only professional, but has notified me when my aging dog has a new limp and bump that may need addressed by my vet, taking the service to a higher standard.
If you need a groomer on the Westside- Balanced is the best! Ask for Kevin.

We have a large husky possible malamute mix. This means a lot of fur and more fur. Balanced Dog Grooming is the only place that can manage all the floof and she comes out like a brand new dog. The technicians really know how to groom her and they are super thoughtful about her welfare. Thank you guys for being the best, see you again soon!
Always so sweet to my pup!

We had a great experience! We ended up running a little late for our appointment and they were so understanding.This was the first time getting our adopted Australian Shepherd groomed so we didn’t know what to expect. They treated him so well and made him feel so comfortable. Best of all they did an excellent job and he looks so handsome. We’ll definitely be coming back 👍🏽
Outstanding, excellent service and always professional.

Kevin is an artist. Truly. He stripped Willow’s wire hair. Very few places have groomers who do stripping. It’s a laborious 3 hour deshedding suggested annually for wire hair coats. Then Kevin went above and beyond with shaping details. We are SO pleased, thank you, Kevin.

We love Kevin at Balanced Dog!! We just moved to LA in September and finding a good groomer proved to be a bit more difficult than we expected….thankfully we found Kevin and have been sending our 8 year old cockapoo to him and he does an incredible job! He takes instructions very well and does EXACTLY what we ask him to do and does it better than we expect every time!! You can tell that he’s a big dog lover so we always feel good about leaving her with him because we know she’s always in good hands!the service is a bit pricey but i chalk it up to being LA- sadly it means I can’t tip as much as I would like to but the service cost is well worth the results we get!! 10/10 would recommend!!!

Where do I start?! Sir Wellington LOVES coming here. He’s been to three other groomers before, and he would always come back really shaken. The groomers would say he was fidgety, which was always weird to me because when I groom him myself… he LOVES it!!

Well guess what?! He loves it here too!

BETH! Wow. My little man looks like a whole GQ model every single time he walks out of that gate. From the amazing smell when you first walk in, to all the passionate and informed professionals… like come onnnn. I’m honestly upset I didn’t bring my angel here sooner.

And the photos below STILL don’t fully capture Beth’s amazing work.

If you’re debating whether this is the right place… PLEASE don’t second guess it. Book your fur baby’s appointment already!!

Thank you so much, Beth, for loving on our Fat Fat 🥹 He absolutely adores you. And thank you, Anndrea, for your knowledge, kindness, and just your amazing aura! The passion is felt throughout your company.
We absolutely love Balanced dog grooming! We’ve been customers for at least 3 years now. Always excellent job.
Jasmine was wonderful with my 9-month old dachshund. And she gave him a wonderful FIRST GROOM! He looks awesome
Wonderful experience!! We have been coming here for awhile.  Beckett has never looked better. The staff is great.
We absolutely love Balance, they do an amazing job every time. They take such great care of our little girl, Happy, and the staff is always kind, treating all of us with tender loving care. ❤️🥰😘 …

We’ve had nothing but great experiences at The Balanced Dog. The individualized rooms help our pup with anxiety that others places bring with large rooms and / or kennels. Everyone is SO nice 🐾 Beth did an incredible job with Doris today, wow.

I realize the cost of grooming at Balanced Dog is on the high side of the spectrum.  I keep returning because my dog has a specific appointment, he doesn’t sit in a crate for hours on end.  And the results are always excellent.

Highly rec this groomer! I have a fearful little long hair chihuahua and I am amazed at how they were able to help him overcome his fear of nail cutting! It was very convenient- they are a mobile groomer and come to our neighborhood at harbor Marina.

I took Dakota in as the rescue I got her from had taken her there.  I was hoping to use the same girl Dakota met on her first visit. Unfortunately, she was no longer with them but they suggested Kevin and I agreed. When I picked her up, she was wagging and happy! I got to see all the undercoat that had come off her (a whole other dog) and Kevin told me she got tired of standing and needed breaks, which he supplied her. Her nose and paws were much softer, her hair less bulky and she actually looked thinner. I love that they don't have cages and the dogs can walk around in the back. The biggest thing was that she seemed to like Kevin. I will definitely be returning for her next grooming. Thank you Kevin and Balanced Dog Grooming.
Very good! So excited 🤗

Our first time was today!  After much anticipation for our little guy, hoping for a great overall experience and great look, Balance Dog did not disappoint!  Our dog not only looks great, but it's pretty obvious he had a great first time experience.  We've been home a little over an hour, our little guy is tired & resting, but the staff at Balance Dog helped our first time process run really smooth.  They were done in 2 1/2 hours as described and honored our set appointment.  Andrea is a great leader who leads by example, very good communication skills and her care for the pets that come into her business are very well cared for by not only Andrew, but her staff as well.  It's obvious, it's part of the culture at Balanced Dog!  Thank you Andrea!

Blessings,
The Melgoza's
(Bear's / Osito's family)
Excellent - very responsive - kind and caring. I get so many compliments on my golden doodle’s cut since coming to Balanced Dog- highly recommend!

I love Balanced Dog! They are great with my newly rescued boy and take very good care of him. They are very efficient (~45 mins) and provide updates on when I can expect him to be ready. He always leaves with his tail wagging and a smile on his face! They also have a variety of high quality dog treats and accessories. While it is a bit pricey, the convenience, quality of services and special care he receives is worth it!
Taryn is wonderful!

We love Balanced Dog Grooming! It’s a little pricier but worth it for the convenience and comfort of our fur baby. He always comes out so happy and relaxed and looking so sly with his new fresh cut. The groomers are professional and very loving to our animals.

Update! Another great experience at Balanced Dog! Toby is an older dog with heart and auto immune condition.Kevin was gentle and Toby looks great!! Our little dogs are so sensitive so it’s such a blessing to have kevin help with their care. Toby hates to have his nails done, but kevin’s got the magic touch. Never a peep from behind the doors. Such a relief that he’s comfortable. Our little girl Tashi is the same. Recommend!

Have been bringing my double-coated dog here since the location opened.  We always get great service from every groomer we've seen – usually for bath & brush, sometimes adding paw trimming services.  I also love that they have the mobile teeth cleaning van visit monthly.

Great to have in the neighborhood!
THE best groomer. My dog lights up and runs to her every time he sees her. She and her company are so kind and caring - not to mention so talented! This is the place to go

Balanced dog is excellent. First and foremost they are kind and gentle with our dog, a 20lb Shih Tzu mix. The business is very efficient and the groomers are excellent. Everyone that works there is incredibly friendly and professional. Best haircut/bath/groom for our dog in the Venice area by far. Thanks Jasmine!

Sailor loves going to Balanced Dog for grooming! She used to try to run out the door whenever I took her for a bath, but here she goes right in. They are skilled, friendly  and kind to my energetic 75 pound golden retriever and I so appreciate their service.

Have been coming here with my dog Fred since we moved to the neighborhood! The staff is extremely caring/tender with my very scared guy and always manage to make him comfortable while giving quality results. We always leave very happy and satisfied!

Great.  Took my cat in for a nail trim, since he hates it and won't let me do it.  We are traveling, and at the vet at home it takes two, and he screams the entire time.  Here, she was able to quickly trim while I held him, and he barely made a fuss.  We will be back!
We love Balanced Dog! The mobile grooming units are the best and they provide great 1 on 1 attention. Would highly recommend if you live close by in the Marina or Venice!

This place is awesome! My dog is dutch shepherd/pit mix who has some early trauma from previous owner and is not a fan of a lot of paw handling. Not to mention he's an intimidating dog for people he doesn't know. But that was no problem for Kevin who trims his nails now on a regular basis. He's super friendly, very efficient with the trimming and couldn't be more supportive and helpful! 5 stars all day!
My dog Fiona Apple is always in the best hands here! Love the attention to detail they provide with my special requests especially because she’s got a unique jaw :) Would highly recommend!

My two pups have been getting groomed here for a few years and they always do such a great job! The groomers and the owners are very friendly and accommodating to my schedule. My two pups always look beautiful after every groom. It's such a nice convenience having their mobile grooming in the marina!

My dog is very old and fragile so I was worried about her. The people at balanced body are so kind and gentle and I appreciated the care they took to provide my old girl a beautiful experience. Thank you!

Balanced Dog groomed my fluffy, matted, long haired CAT and did an EXCELLENT job. I believe the groomer’s name was Nicolette. I hope I’m correct.
Long-story-short - my CAT now has a groomer. Thank you Balanced Dog!

I brought my little guy Oliver in for grooming. Anndrea and Kevin were very nice and the space was clean/welcoming.

They allowed me to walk into the back/grooming area with Oliver to make him more comfortable with his new surroundings.

I like that they have separate grooming rooms/stations and no cages which I think Oliver appreciated.

First cut was a success. We will go back again.

Choosing the perfect grooming spot for your furry friend can be a bit of a puzzle. Some places make you wait for ages, leaving you stuck all afternoon, just hoping for a call or text to let you know they’re ready to be picked up. Others might not quite get the unique grooming needs of different breeds. Honestly, our pets can tell if their grooming time was a breeze or a nightmare. But don’t worry, our Yorkiepoo discovered his happy place at Balanced Dog Grooming! It’s a cozy spot in the neighborhood where you and your pet can feel calm and relaxed, without a care in the world.
So happy with Balanced Dog Grooming! They treated my pup with such care —highly recommend ❤️❤️❤️
Bear is sensitive to dog groomers but here he feels comfortable and loved. Thanks y’all!
Kevin is amazing with Luca! They are so friendly, professional and warm.
Fabulous help and services with newly rescued scared pup! So appreciate your care and thoughtful handling of my precious pup! 🙏🏻🐾😍 …

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I bring my Bengal, Luna, here just for nail trims — and let me tell you, she is not an easy cat to handle! Bengals are smart, strong, and have big personalities, but the groomers handles her with such calm and confidence. I’m always amazed how quickly and safely they get it done with zero drama.
They truly understand cats and make the whole experience stress-free (for both Luna and me!). It’s such a relief knowing I can trust someone to care for her gently but firmly. I wouldn’t take her anywhere else for nail trimming — they’re absolute pros! 🐾

I love how each dog gets their own room and they don’t use cages. The caveat is that you have to pick up your dog right after their grooming appointment within 15 minutes. Regardless, everyone seems very loving and caring at Balanced Dog and my dog looks so amazing and is excited after her grooming. This is the only place I really feel comfortable taking her to.
We so appreciate their warmth and excellent service! Thank you!

I’ve been bringing my pup here for 2 years and they nail it every time. He normally spooks with strangers, but here he waltzes in like he’s on payroll. He comes out looking so good I get compliments on him daily (no joke). The staff is gentle, patient, and they don’t crate. when dog flu was going around they even had private waiting rooms with TVs. As a hover dad, this place clears my bar and then some. Highly recommend. Love them
They always do such a great job grooming my dog and are so friendly and personable! Their pop-up in the marina is so convenient
Wonderful place. Highly recommend

OMG me and my dog loved this place soo much!!! So ive been searching so many groomers around this area to make sure my dog is safe especially this is her first time grooming and i wanted her to get a good impression of grooming. So I choose here. It was her first time to go to groomers and Jessica was super professional I asked paw trim, nail trim, ear plucking and face hair cut and it took only 20mins which is crazy i tried to cut her nails but i would never able to even hold her feet.. And my dog was so quiet during grooming. The place is super clean SMELLS SO GOOD and staffs and groomers SUPER DUPER NICE I cant wait to go back for complete groom in few weeks! + I also loved the price too. And look at my dog smiling😍😍😍😍 she satisfied it
Our Sierra came back more beautiful than ever! Andrea was terrific and was so easy to work with. We will definitely be back!
Balanced Dog is the best! They’re so patient and caring with my dog, Archie, even with his quirks. Always a great experience—highly recommend for grooming!
This place is so great! Everyone was friendly and they did such an amazing job with my puppy Fred getting him groomed and tidy. Can’t wait to come back for our next service in a few weeks! 😊

Excellent & friendly staff. Our dog Willow is a bit on the timid side & can take a minute to open up to people. The staff does an exceptional job of making her and us feel comfortable, and did not turn her away like other places. They are patient, sweet, and accommodating. We love the balanced dog and our dog does too! I would highly recommend!

We took our puppy here after she had a bad experience at her first grooming appointment at another local spot. Here they were really gentle handling her when we dropped her off and our puppy came out acting normal and not shell shocked or anxious at all. They even took a little video of trimming her face and we got to see that she was fine during her appointment. This place is a bit pricier than other options we were considering but they did a great job so I feel like it was worth it for us.

Maddie at the front is so helpful and sweet
Jazzzzzzzz is an absolute 😇 Scooby loved her thank you for the best experience …
Very friendly and caring people.
My pup looks great!  They followed my wishes regarding how to trim her face and tail.  They were super kind and made me feel better about having a bit of a nervous dog.  Wll def go back!

They did an absolutely fantastic job on our pup Casper! Only our 3rd time getting our pup groomed because our previous groomer stated Casper was difficult. He would come home and not be himself for days. This time was not the case! He looks the best he’s ever looked after a grooming appointment and he’s still the happy and healthy pup we dropped off! Thank you so much!

Taryn & Anndrea took such great care of my 12 year old Pomeranian & 1 & half year old Husky with luxating patella issues. Grooming can be traumatic but I knew they were safe as both ladies asked all the right questions & were so loving, gentle & patient. My dogs are happy & look gorgeous. I am booking regularly with them as I know my fur babies are in the best hands 🏆❤️ so happy I found them 😍

We love Balanced Dog! Andrea takes perfect care of my midsized Australian Shepherd (double cut), and always delivers exactly what I'm asking for! Love her attentiveness, and they are always prompt with letting me know when my pup is ready to be picked up. We've been going here for just under a year, and this is *our* spot for grooming!

Great place to get your dog groomed. I was stressing trying to find a place to hand strip my Wire Fox Terrier Remy. They were super informative, welcoming, and did a superb job. Can't recommend enough.

🐈 🐈 🐈🐈 “Hi! Pumpkin and Marine here,  😸
We pretend to hate bath time, but truth be told—we love our groomer from Balanced Dog! She’s way gentler than the other groomers we’ve had (no post-spa trauma naps needed), and best of all… no scary car rides! We just roll up to our mobile spa day in style—in our wagon. ✨

Honestly, they should rename it to Balanced Cat, because let’s face it… cats rule and dogs drool 😹
. Each visit, we leave looking smoother and more fabulous than ever. ⭐️ Five paws up every time! 🐾🐾🐾🐾🐾⭐️
Thank you for always fitting us in and making us look this cute—especially when your schedule is packed!

We absolutely love balanced dog grooming! As dog trainers with plenty of personal dogs, and tons of client dogs, we can’t think of anywhere we would rather send pups in our care for a bath or a cut. They’re always friendly, helpful and take the best care of our dogs. We highly recommend Balanced Dog Grooming and the wonderful staff at their Venice location!
Iris is the best with my 14 year old chucky! Great groomers!

My bulldog is not the easiest to groom. I made an appointment to get her nails trimmed and was concerned that it might not happen. My pup turned to leave the minute i walked toward the entrance. Undaunted, But Andrea, the groomer, came outside and bent down to “walk” Mali into the space. She has a bulldog herself which helps with the particularly stubbornness that Bulldogs have. She put her arms around my dogs waist and guided my pup inside. They allowed me to come into the room with her so I was an able to hold while Andrea clipped and filed. Andrea and the whole place is amazing. Maddie who works the front office assured me that i could come in with her and even offered for me to do a few practice runs to check out the space prior to the appointment. They are warm, professional and reasonable priced. I will definitely return.
These are not groomers, They are magicians! By Birdie (Bernese Mountain Dog) always loves feeling so clean and perfectly pretty. But I love the products they use and the empathy they show my baby.
Andrea and team are top notch. My dog Sushi is usually not a big fan of groomers but they treat her so well at Balanced Dog!
Great grooming service!
These guys always do an amazing job grooming my dog ziggy! Highly recommend!
Perfect service

The staff was very friendly and clearly great at what they do. I came in with a detailed list of notes for my dog's haircut, and they made sure to address every one. The facilities were clean, the atmosphere was calming, and I could tell my dog wasn’t stressed at all.

Today I took my dog Snoopy to Balanced Dog Grooming for the first time and absolutely loved it. They were super professional, and treated my baby with the best care. He looked so relax and happy when I picked him up. And the service was amazing!!

I've been taking my dog to Balanced Dog for over a year now, and couldn't be happier. Every staff member is incredibly kind, and the facility is spotless and well-maintained.

They always take time to communicate clearly before each grooming appointment, and they pay attention to any concerns we bring up.

What I appreciate the most is that even though it's a fairly large grooming shop, the owner, Anndrea, is still hands-on and actively grooming alongside the team. That gives me a lot of trust and confidence in the care they provide :)
Wonderful staff! Dogs look beautiful you can tell they were groomed with lots of love
Absolutely the best grooming service, one on one and the sweetest, most attentive care! My Frenchie has allergies and rashes and they take the best care of him and his skin!
I loved the way they treated my dog, thank you
Thanks Kevin for taking care of Clementine for her first groom. She looks & smells great! We will definitely be back
They do such an incredible job of styling my dogs!! My two tiny dogs always walk out of Balanced Dog looking amazing - they are artists and manage to make my scruffy rescues look extra chic!

I’ve tried many places to take my pup for grooming and I am so glad we found this place! My pup Chalupa does great here and we keep coming back. He’s not super anxious at drop off and when I pick him up he’s bright and even gives the staff kisses. He’s incredibly soft after and they take great care of him!  Chalupa gives his paw 🐾  of approval 🐶

Kevin is our regular groomer at Balanced Dog and he is the best I’ve found since I rescued my dog a year ago. We’re lucky we live just 5 minutes away but if we ever move, I would drive to keep coming to Kevin. My dog is passive but extremely timid and scared, especially of men. Kevin is the only man he has ever been comfortable with and he’s so relaxed around him and in the shop. He’s a little nervous when he goes in but he comes out so happy and confident. And Kevin does such an amazing job, he is so silky and handsome when he comes out. I generally ask groomers to not use any scented products but I let them do their thing here because the products are natural and the scent is fresh, not artificial or too strong. I love the staff too, they have taught me so much during our chats while I’m waiting for grooming, I got some great tips on cleaning his teeth at home which I was struggling with and they have a team that is available month for canine dental cleaning without anesthesia which I love. And they always have fun products in the storefront, my only problem is that I can’t resist spending a small fortune every time I come in because I find so many neat products for my dog and there’s always something new I haven’t seen before. We love Kevin and Balanced Dog and I recommend them to everyone (people stop me on the street often to ask about my dog and where he’s groomed, he looks that good!)
Balanced Groomers did a perfect, wonderful, beautiful job on Kobe!  We are soooo happy and wholeheartedly recommend Balanced Doggie Groomers to all who love their doggies.

Awesome service! Love the attention to detail about my doggie’s needs. Always a great experience. I’m one of those dog mom’s who’s super careful (and afraid something might go wrong with my old girl).👀 So relieved to have found a dog grooming service with thoughtful, caring, generous, and knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend them!
Very helpful, attentive staff. They always go above and beyond to help with scheduling around my busy work day, and Winnie always comes home looking fresh and fly! Definitely recommend.

Amazing staff excellent service .
Really like the results.

Convenient, professional, competitively priced.

I have a huge Great Pyrenees mix that sheds like no other. She can be a lot to handle. But balanced dog handles her with grace and care. I will be a loyal customer moving forwarded after just trying them once.

Not to mention they’re mobile!

Update: Balanced Dog continues to do a great job. Gabbie hates to get her nails trimmed but they were so gentle and patient with her! So nice and friendly. My dog is a nervous girl but she always does so well when I take her.
Balanced dog was a wonderful spa experience.The professional staff made my nervous senior dog so comfortable. She came home happy and looking beautiful. We will definitely return !

The groomers at Balanced Dog are the best! They make my standard poodle look like a show dog and my sweet rescue chow mix like a glorious lion. They make everything so easy for the owner and communicate very well. They also care about the dogs comfort and don’t put them in cages to dry or wait. They hang out in nice little suites and watch cartoons.

Hands down the best place I have found to take care of my Kassie girl! She is a 94lb pup that LOATHES getting her nails done… that being said, it had been a while since I had gotten them done and she ripped a nail causing bleeding and discomfort. They were able to get her in same day and we were booked with Tim. Omg! He is the best!!! Tim was so patient with her even though she was like a bucking bronco the whole time. He gave  me advice and I scheduled again. Fast ford 6 months later, she has drastically improved, walks in the door no problem and is manageable. I have even been able to stop medicating her prior to the appointments which is so important to me. I have gone to other places in the past and it felt like her trauma just escalated, here at Balanced Dog it has improved and she is so much happier! The lady at the front desk is always super sweet and very responsive.

Thank you to the whole team there!
We love Balanced Dog grooming! They are so kind and do such an amazing job bathing and grooming our pup. He loves to come here!

Tim is a fantastic groomer and he took special care of my long hair cat. She's very timid and shy and normally after bringing her home from the vet or other groomers, she would be very anxious and hide under the bed for hours. She hasn't hid at all after bringing her home from Balanced dog grooming. This is the pet groomer I'll use going forward.
The folks at Balanced Dog really care about your pup.  That’s the difference.

I love going to this place to get my dog’s nails cut since she won’t let me do it at home. The woman who works at the front desk (I forget her name, but I know she has an Australian shepherd!) is super friendly and outgoing and was really nice to my dog. Will definitely only be coming here for Shadow’s nail cuts from now on ☺️
the best place to take my anxious chihuahua 😁 …

For anyone who has an anxious dog I highly highly recommend Balanced Dog. My dog usually is very upset after groomings, but it’s obvious that Kevin took a lot of patient care with her. I love that they do everything crate-free and dogs receive 1:1 attention.

Balanced Dog is super! They gave a really great bath for Luna.and squeezed us in same day! We're new to Venice and my dog has gone to the same place for 8 years. They were patient with her in a new groomers. Thank you!
Amazing service, sweet staff, and love that it’s cage free for our anxious doodle to feel most comfortable. They even have a mini yard for them to potty and take decompression breaks!
